findings.title: XSS Vulnerability in Dalgona CTF Challenge
findings.description: The /page endpoint is vulnerable to Cross-Site Scripting (XSS). The application filters <script> tags but allows event handler-based XSS payloads. Successful XSS execution is confirmed by the server returning a success indicator (new_star.png image).
findings.evidence:
Payload: Server response shows success indicator:

Let the game begin. Good Luck
Failed payloads (script tags filtered) return:

Failed! Try again!
The flag is displayed in the browser when XSS executes successfully, but could not be captured without a browser environment.

reproduction.expected: Response contains new_star.png indicating successful XSS execution
